decisions.reason: The modular mobile processing concept has proven customer value with reported annual savings of over €600,000 and fits the firm's strategy around modular, application-specific recycling solutions.
This mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core product range and its continued dedicated presentation in 2023 and 2024 suggests it supports the firm's growing mainstream business.
The product has a clear reference case, quantified savings and ongoing website presence, indicating commercial traction in a strategic modular solution area.

Although newly launched, the slow-speed shredders are tightly aligned with the firm's established offer and a growing German machinery firm would usually give such core-line extensions more time to scale.
The mobile spiral shaft screens extend the firm's processing portfolio in line with its innovation and modularization direction, and there is no sign yet of market failure.
